raw_response:
I am too old to learn new ways with chemicals I do not understand, and these trees have fed my family for many years with what God and my animals provide. I will put manure from my cattle on this plot as I have always done, and my children will help me weed and gather the harvest when the time comes. We do not have money for hired workers or store-bought sprays, and I trust the rains to come as they always have.
